reader_summary.headline: Today we are breaking down Informa.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down Informa. At its core Informa is a live events business headquartered in the UK. While media conversations often revolve around consumer giants like Disney. I am joined by Nick Shenton from Artemis Investment Management.

key_points.text: While media conversations often revolve around consumer giants like Disney.
With nearly 1,000 live events across industries ranging from pharmaceuticals to maritime.
These industry events come with a compelling financial model, which Nick details.
